minimalRepairPolicy: Edit the current v2 beauty crops locally using the frozen guide hidden-span masks. Restore only foreground cover; do not add a branch to avoid a gap.
Use blood widths plus a restrained shadow fringe for the repair selection. Keep the original named ports, curve centerlines, colors, organ silhouettes and crop framing.
Any incidental contact between new blood and preserved AI vessel pigment must remain an over/under projection unless the final graph explicitly shares the named endpoint.
For bronchial crossings preserve the original lighter matte-blue branch shape and make the vascular underpass unambiguous; never attach blood to an airway tip.
After correcting the candidates, independently inspect the new images and compare original crop boundaries/ports again before a controlled registered composite.
limits: This is a game-art projection review, not a clinical anatomy certification.
Source coordinates of hidden spans and named ports come exactly from the final graph. Observed beauty-image locations are approximate until a controlled source-coordinate composite exists.
The generated crops recolor/re-render pixels throughout their frames, so untouched original head/limb/body boundary pixel identity cannot be claimed for direct replacement.
Appearance of a continuous colored pipe does not prove graph connectivity, supply/return direction, simulation passability or collision clearance.
All reported findings refer to v2 candidate hashes. Later corrected versions require a separate review.
